ctx.x: What about (inaudible)? I mean, you've had a fair amount to say about the whole business of jazz. Has either one of them or both of them done something good in terms of the jazz musician?

(Inaudible), I never worked for him. When Billie Holiday demanded that he hire me because (inaudible), I did the first jazz philharmonic cheap because he's (inaudible). To work for nothing, because these two guys (inaudible) money. With George ______, they never paid enough money, man. Just before I got sick, I was able to find some agents who paid enough money. (Inaudible) ten dollars a concert. George ______ would have laughed if anybody asked for that kind of money.
That's interesting, because thre are classical musicians, and not only the very famous ones, the ones who are coming up, who get $10,000 a concert, but very few jazz people have ever done that.
